imagine.note: A direction/strategy or project proposal was declined with 'not with brand money'.

must_draft.intent: One strategy draft citing the decline reason — we do not take brand money.

payload.body: Small money, many hands. No restaurant. RIVER vouchers with the growers. We do not take brand money.

lines.text: Small money, many hands — the stall funds the hall, not a grant round.
No restaurant. Two days a week, not a fleet.
RIVER vouchers keep value with the growers, not the middle.
We do not take brand money.

payload.diff: add: We do not take brand money.

cases.why_gold: A decline reason that states a constraint yields one strategy draft citing the reason. This is the preview's 'no brand money' line, written when someone actually said it on a rejection — not invented from the air.

imagine.note: A hardware-vendor project was declined: 'not if it locks the coop to one inverter brand'.

cases.why_gold: Same shape on Energy: a reasoned rejection becomes a strategy constraint, one draft, the reason as receipt.

imagine.note: Harvest proposal rejected with an empty reason.

cases.why_gold: A decline with no reason yields nothing. Strategy is not inferred from a silent no.

imagine.note: Rejected 'not this quarter — wait for EECF'.

cases.why_gold: A reason about timing is not a constraint the org will live by. It is a calendar. No strategy draft.
